taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Atomic security invariants across composed API operations
controls.source_trace: Identify a policy that must remain true across operations and whether an early permitted mutation persists when a later prerequisite fails.
controls.implementation_branch: Write the exact invariant crossing the transaction before constructing the fixture. A documented best-effort API does not imply financial atomicity, and a transaction rollback does not undo external side effects automatically. Inspect database and external stub state separately when the operation spans both.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a small local synthetic batch with a deliberate second-step denial and inspect final state, alongside a legitimate successful batch.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A documented partial-success API is not automatically broken; establish the intended all-or-nothing security invariant.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Align transaction/compensation behavior with the invariant and retest failures at each material boundary.
